title: Implement MCP transport runtime and bridge registration boundaries
description: TASK-029 created typed MCP models, but real MCP parity still needs stdio/SSE/streamable HTTP transport runtime, process supervision, noisy-stdout tolerant JSON-RPC parsing, reconnect, and registration of resource/prompt/tools into the tool catalog.

files.change: Define stdio and HTTP transport ports, process lifecycle, JSON-RPC framing, reconnect policy, and tolerant stdout filtering.
Convert MCP tools/resources/prompts into astrbot-tool catalog entries without plugin/provider ownership.

criteria: MCP process supervision is owned by astrbot-mcp, not runtime handle or plugin sandbox internals.
Synthetic resource/prompt tools register through astrbot-tool catalog descriptors.
Transport parsing and reconnect behavior can be tested with fake stdio/HTTP streams.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-mcp && cargo test -p astrbot-tool && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
